newsitem.title: USA: Mother who had nails done while baby died is jailed.
newsitem.headline: Mother who had nails done while baby died is jailed.

text.p: A woman whose infant son died of malnutrition while she was having a manicure was ordered held in jail on Tuesday to await trial next month.

Dianna Meeks, 25, whose four other young children were in protective custody, will have a preliminary hearing on June 17 where she will face a charge of involuntary manslaughter in the death last Thursday of her eight-week-old son Dontory Jordan.

Prosecutors said Meeks ignored a medical clinic doctor's order last week to take Dontory to the hospital because he weighed only three pounds (1.36 kg), down from his birthweight of nearly six pounds (2.72 kg).

Prosecutors said that Meeks instead went shopping and took Dontory with her to a manicurist, where she was having her nails done as he died. Authorities said he had nothing in his stomach and had no baby fat.
